caption: Ionic current in the gel and tissue crosses the double layer at each metal contact and becomes electron current in the wire. The two half-cell potentials sit back to back, so they cancel only when the electrodes match.

spec.title: Electrode–electrolyte path
spec.aria: A block diagram showing the path from a metal electrode through the double layer, electrolyte gel and skin tissue to a reference electrode, with each metal contact forming one half-cell.
